post.description: Rank chunks of one corpus version for a query. Defaults to the current version.

Build the dense index for a corpus version from its stored chunks (no re-ingestion).

Idempotent: returns the ready or in-progress index if there is one. Otherwise starts a build
(202) in the background; poll GET for progress. A failed or stale index is rebuilt.

rank.title: Rank
rank.description: Rank in that retriever's candidates; null if absent

normalized_score.title: Normalized Score
normalized_score.description: Weighted fusion only: min-max normalised score in 0..1

contribution.title: Contribution
contribution.description: This component's share of the fused score

ComponentScore.title: ComponentScore
ComponentScore.description: How one component retriever saw a fused chunk. Raw scores are never rescaled here.

ContentOrigin.title: ContentOrigin
ContentOrigin.description: Where a piece of information came from. Every value shown to a user carries one.

CorpusVersion.title: CorpusVersion
CorpusVersion.description: An immutable snapshot: which document versions the corpus contained.

embedded.title: Embedded
embedded.description: Progress: chunks with a vector so far

content_hash.title: Content Hash
content_hash.description: SHA-256 over chunk ids and exact vector bytes; set when ready

DenseIndex.title: DenseIndex
DenseIndex.description: One build of a dense index for a corpus version under one embedder config.

DenseIndexState.title: DenseIndexState
DenseIndexState.description: What the UI may promise for a corpus version under the configured embedder.

index.description: Latest build for this version, if any

DenseIndexView.title: DenseIndexView
DenseIndexView.description: Whether a corpus version has a usable dense index under the configured embedder.

Document.title: Document
Document.description: A logical document, identified within its corpus by filename. Content lives in versions.

current_version_id.title: Current Version Id
current_version_id.description: Version in the corpus's current version; null if the document was removed

EmbedderInfo.title: EmbedderInfo
EmbedderInfo.description: The spec plus facts read from the loaded model files.

query_prefix.title: Query Prefix
query_prefix.description: Instruction prepended to queries (not documents), per the model card
query_prefix.default: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

EmbedderSpec.title: EmbedderSpec
EmbedderSpec.description: What determines an embedding. Its hash keys every stored vector.

weights.title: Weights
weights.description: Weighted fusion only: one weight per component, each 0..1, summing to 1

weights.title: Weights
weights.description: Weighted fusion only: one weight per component, each 0..1, summing to 1

IngestionRecord.title: IngestionRecord
IngestionRecord.description: Provenance of one ingestion operation. Immutable once written.

RetrievalConfiguration.title: RetrievalConfiguration
RetrievalConfiguration.description: Everything that determines a ranked result set, resolved. The unit an experiment varies.

relevance.title: Relevance
relevance.description: Graded relevance judgements; grade > 0 counts as relevant.

RetrievalHit.title: RetrievalHit
RetrievalHit.description: One retrieved chunk with everything needed to display and trace it.
